fusions.name: Sip at the Vein
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Ringing Steel
fusions.desc: Strikes a note off the blade that deals 3 damage to everything within 4 tiles ahead of you, with a 35% chance to leave each target with [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flicker Through Dark
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Crimson Tithe
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
